## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `35cf050ecf3ddaeb69b669c471a4ef61e2854803`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/cloud.md + none
Security-touching: no

Review of objectstack-ai/objectstack PR #34606 for card objectstack-ai/cloud#4749 (with objectstack-ai/cloud#3779). Inputs: both cards with every comment, the PR body, file list, the net diff against `main` at `8dd8192c` (merge base `144cdc25`), and the check-runs on the head. Read to judge, not reviewed: cloud `AGENTS.md` rule 7 on cloud `main` (`3acee2b8`) and on cloud PR #4754's head (`b1749637`), cloud `.github/workflows/test.yml` and root `turbo.json`, and the line ceilings in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`.

### ① Derived judgments

- File list: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/cloud.md` only, 1 line added and 1 removed, line 28 (item ③ of the CI-minutes entry). Right: it matches the PR body.
- Before (set by PR #34416, merged): `ci:full` only for pin rounds (`.objectstack-sha` changes) and PRs that change `.github/workflows/**`, the rest run the affected tier. After: `ci:full` only for pin rounds, PRs that change `.github/workflows/**` and PRs that change repo-root files, with a pointer to cloud `AGENTS.md` rule 7.
- Size: the file stays at 28 lines against a ceiling of 28, and line 28 is 119 bytes against the 120-byte line ceiling (read from the tree; the ratchet itself was not run here).
- Check-runs on the head: the PR is a draft, so most jobs are skipped, and skipped is not a pass. Completed with success: `Auto Label`, `Test UI`, `Test Core`, `Dogfood Regression Gate` (the three aggregate jobs over skipped shards) and `Lint · scoped · query-options erasure`. `Lint · CI, release & engine gates` was still in progress at the time of this record, so it has no verdict yet; the seat reads it before ACCEPT. The only gate evidence for the pm-skill checks is the dev's own container run in the PR body, which this record does not adopt as a gate verdict.
- No accept-set, schema or public-surface change: skill prose only.

### ② Semver level

Nothing is published: one internal skill reference file. The PR carries `skip-changeset`, which matches. `Clause-②: no` on the PR body and the card; the diff agrees.

### ③ Boundary flags

- No `open_questions` and no deviation flags on the PR.
- Landing order, for the seat: this PR and cloud PR #4754 are a pair. If #4754 lands first, this lane line on objectstack `main` still says two classes with 「只给」, which forbids the label that cloud rule 7 requires on a root-file PR; this PR closes that gap. If this PR lands first, the pointer already resolves: cloud `main` rule 7 carries the cloud#4746 sentence that requires `ci:full` on root-file PRs. Either order is safe; the window is shortest if both merge together.
- The branch is behind objectstack `main`; the three-dot diff is the one line and the line on `main` at `8dd8192c` is the one the PR replaces, so no conflict is implied. Rule 7 of cloud does not apply here; no action is owed.
- SQL push-down: not applicable, no code.

### ④ Design judgment

`lanes/cloud.md` line 28 against the rule it points to.

- Against cloud `AGENTS.md` rule 7 on PR #4754's head: rule 7 there says 「`ci:full` 只给三类 PR：pin 轮次（`.objectstack-sha` 有变化）、改 `.github/workflows/**` 的 PR，以及上面说的改到仓根文件、受影响档会扩成全部包的 PR；其余 PR 走受影响档」. The lane line names the same three classes in the same order, keeps 「只给」, and points to rule 7 for the detail. Agrees.
- Against cloud `main`: rule 7 has no 「只给」 sentence yet, but it carries cloud#4746's sentence that a PR without `ci:full` that changes the repo-root files which widen the affected tier to every package must add `ci:full` and push. The two-class lane line on objectstack `main` contradicts that sentence; the three-class line does not. Agrees, and it fixes a live contradiction.
- Against the workflow: cloud `test.yml` line 1013 caps a `pull_request` without the label at 50 minutes and with it at 60, so the third class has a real effect. Holds.
- What the line dropped. 「余走受影响档」: implied by 「只给」, and stated in rule 7. The gloss 「`.objectstack-sha` 变」 on pin rounds: stated in rule 7 on #4754's head, and a standing term in this lane. Neither loss changes the rule.
- Attempt to break it: 「改仓根文件的 PR」 read alone. See N1.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

- N1 (nit) — 「改仓根文件的 PR」 is wider on its face than the class it stands for. Rule 7 means the repo-root files that widen the affected tier to every package (lockfile, `vitest.shared.ts`, root `turbo.json`, `.objectstack-sha` and the like, the list `tier.mjs` reads from root `turbo.json`), not every file at the repo root: `README.md` and `AGENTS.md` are repo-root files too, and a PR that changes only those runs the affected tier. The pointer in the same line names rule 7 as the authority, and a card thread reads cloud `AGENTS.md` in any case, so the contract is not changed; the cost of the loose reading is a full-tier run that was not needed. The line is 119 bytes of 120, so a tighter wording has to trade for it, for example dropping the second 「cloud 」 (line 27 already names cloud `AGENTS.md`) to make room for a qualifier.
- N2 (nit) — the PR title says 「repo-root test inputs」 while the line says 「仓根文件」. The files in question are turbo global dependencies and root test inputs both; the line and rule 7 are the contract, the title is not.
